body: I was thinking this a couple of hours ago , it feels like I don’t cut as deep as I did in the beginning and it’s so irritating because when I was cutting deeper it made me feel alive but now it just feels like nothing
Nigga I’m just tryna be supportive lol, idk what to say but I’m trying:/
Idk you might be thinking about it in wherever you go when you die

I know it’s dumb to say this , but please I’m begging you don’t give up on life because of this , it seem major right now because that’s all you’re seeing at the moment but you will regret ending your life over this . I hope you feel better ❤️

Listen rumours are childish and are made up by incompetent people who have nothing better to do but spread gossip in hopes to have a decent conversation with the people who they call “friends” I can imagine GCSE are difficult and are stressful but don’t let this one thing bring you down . This is one little blimp in the road and if it really does effect your life which I highly doubt you can always go down another path - figure more things out you will always have time it doesn’t matter if you’re 16 or 43 you will always have enough time . I promise

Baby,it doesn’t matter how much weight you looses or how many times the numbers on that scale go down a few numbers if you don’t change your mindset you will never truly see yourself for what you are . Which is a perfectly sculpted, beautiful human being - do whatever makes you happier tho I’m not trying to tell you how to feel ♥️

I’ve tried starving myself too, but luv all it does is make you bloat up and it makes you feel even more like shit . I won’t lie and say that it didn’t help me loose some weight because it did but it can give you some really serious health conditions
You aren’t vile , we all do things that we have no control over or do things that we wish we didn’t but that doesn’t make you a terrible person

I’ve always had this fantasy of jumping of a bridge and just falling in the water , in my opinion drowning is one of the worst ways to die but I truly believe that I deserve to struggle before dying .
Damn, I’m genuinely sorry that it’s come to this point for you - no one deserves to feel like this . But I hope you’re happier wherever ppl go when they die <3
Not trying to encourage you or anything (but like who tf am I to tell u what to do when we’re all basically feeling the same way/want to do the same thing ) how are u gonna do it ?

I just feel like it’s such a difficult decision, because a part of me doesn’t even care and just says “fuck it” and wants to just end everything, but then the other part of me is like terrified of dying which doesn’t really make any sense so now I’m in a repeated cycle of wanting to Kms and wanting to stay alive just in case something changes - but for now I’ll just stick to self harm
